name: Adam McIntyre
source:
Adam McIntyre is one of the contestants of America's Most Eligible and one of Your Character's love interests. His default name is "Adam McIntyre", but the player can pick a different name for him. He makes his first appearance in Book 1, Chapter 1.

If Your Character accompanies him down to the beach in Chapter 1, he reveals that when he was on Season 9 of America's Most Eligible, he thought being on the show would give him more opportunities to travel to places he's never been to. In addition, he states that he was looking forward to getting the chance to meet people that he otherwise wouldn't have came across or approached outside of the competition. He confesses that he was a total romantic when he first auditioned, and was hoping to make real connections with the other contestants, maybe even find a partner. In the beginning of the show, he urges Your Character to watch out for the other contestants and not to trust their producer; he tells Your Character that he doesn't want to see them get hurt.
